title: TDengine vs ClickHouse: Which One Actually Scales? ⚡
fb_caption:
TDengine vs ClickHouse: Which Architecture Actually Scales in Production? ⚡

🚀 Throughput: TDengine excels at ingest, ClickHouse at analytical queries.
⚡ Latency: ClickHouse generally lower for OLAP, TDengine optimized for time-series writes.
🛡️ Consistency: Both offer different trade-offs; TDengine leans towards availability.
💥 Failure Modes: Understand distributed vs. clustered architectures.
⚙️ Operational Overhead: TDengine often simpler to manage for time-series specific use cases.

For production time-series workloads prioritizing ingest speed and simplicity, TDengine often takes the lead. For complex analytical queries on large datasets, ClickHouse shines.
